research_mode: official OSR and ONS sources only; police recorded crime quality oversight, CSEW and police-recorded divergence, current March 2026 measurement boundaries and designation controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Police recorded crime production chain
verified_claims: ONS publishes police recorded crime statistics quarterly
the Home Office collates data from 43 territorial police forces and British Transport Police
the Home Office supplies the collated data to ONS
limitations: the production chain does not make force-level recording practices uniform
quarterly publication is not parcel-level evidence

sources.name: Police recorded crime designation
verified_claims: police recorded crime is published as official statistics
its National Statistics designation was removed in 2014
quality and consistency concerns motivated the removal
limitations: official-statistics status is not the same as accredited official statistics
designation applies to the statistical series rather than every operational record

sources.name: Counting Rules review scope
verified_claims: the quality review examined how Home Office Counting Rules are interpreted
the review examined how the rules are applied by police forces
rule interpretation is a potential source of quality variation
limitations: a national rule does not prove identical force implementation
recording-rule compliance is not a parcel safety measure

sources.name: Police force IT-system quality scope
verified_claims: OSR examined the IT systems police forces use to record crime
system strengths and limitations can affect data quality
the review treated technology as part of the end-to-end quality process
limitations: IT-system differences do not by themselves quantify bias
system quality must not be inferred from a force-level total

sources.name: Multi-level quality assurance scope
verified_claims: the review examined quality assurance by police-force analysts
it also examined Home Office quality assurance
ONS quality assurance formed a third level of review
limitations: quality assurance at one level does not replace controls at another
QA processes do not prove that every record is correct

sources.name: Home Office monthly data checks
verified_claims: the Home Office runs a monthly quality-assurance process
the monthly process includes logic checks
the monthly process includes consistency checks
limitations: monthly checks can detect defined anomalies but not every root cause
passing checks is not equivalent to spatial validation

sources.name: Home Office quarterly reconciliation
verified_claims: the Home Office conducts a more detailed quarterly reconciliation
the reconciliation supports data sent to ONS for publication
the quarterly process contains further checks beyond the monthly process
limitations: quarterly reconciliation is publication QA rather than real-time validation
reconciliation cannot be treated as a local crime-rate denominator

sources.name: Strengthened Home Office assurance
verified_claims: OSR found that Home Office quality-assurance processes are well established
the Home Office Data Hub strengthened assurance arrangements
quality processes have improved in recent years
limitations: strengthened assurance does not remove all force-level quality issues
process maturity is not a numerical safety score

sources.name: Force data-quality oversight gap
verified_claims: OSR said the Home Office should strengthen oversight of police-force data quality
gaps remain in understanding force-level quality
published quality information is incomplete
limitations: an oversight gap does not identify the direction or size of error for a particular force
missing quality information must not be replaced with inferred values

sources.name: ONS and Home Office quality knowledge gap
verified_claims: OSR found that both ONS and the Home Office strengthened quality arrangements
OSR also found gaps in their understanding of police-force data quality
communication of quality improved but remained incomplete
limitations: improved communication does not make non-comparable series directly comparable
quality gaps require explicit caveats
